name: Darkroast + Lightroast - Master AV1 QSV
description: Readable universal Movie/TV AV1 QSV flow with visible bitrate branches and dedicated original-language, audio, subtitle and Dolby Vision policy nodes. v0.1.1 adds QSV-safe AV1 10-bit handling.

inputsDB.code: module.exports = async (args) => {const t=JSON.stringify(args.inputFileObj?.ffProbeData||{}).toLowerCase();const dv=t.includes('dovi configuration record')||t.includes('dolby vision')||t.includes('dvhe')||t.includes('dvh1');args.jobLog(`[Dolby Vision] ${dv?'Detected - preserve source video':'Not detected - AV1 path allowed'}\n`);return {outputFileObj:args.inputFileObj,outputNumber:dv?1:2,variables:args.variables};};

module.exports = async (args) => {let found=false;for(const t of(args.inputFileObj?.mediaInfo?.track||[])){if(String(t['@type']||'').toLowerCase()==='video'&&Number(t.BitRate)>0)found=true}args.jobLog(`[Bitrate] ${found?'Video bitrate available':'Unavailable - Q20 fallback'}\n`);return {outputFileObj:args.inputFileObj,outputNumber:found?1:2,variables:args.variables};};
